task:
Implement the VLM keyframe MVP in strange_ai on branch codex/vlm-eight-keyframes, grounded by .gjc/context/vlm-keyframe-mvp-20260715T002647Z.md. Preserve --input-url, --output-urls, and nested --metadata. Support local path, file://, HTTP(S). Extract exactly eight deterministic unique JPEG frames in memory at the centers of eight equal clip segments using OpenCV or existing dependencies, with index/timestamp/frame_index/dimensions/SHA-256 metadata. Reject download/decode/FPS/duration/range/short-video/duplicate/encode failures with non-zero exit, no success stdout, and sanitized stderr. Pass exactly eight ordered JPEG byte payloads plus frame timing/order and sanitized incident metadata to MockVlmProvider. Strictly validate the requested vlm-result-v1 schema, finite/nonnegative values, keywords, forbidden identity/demographic/medical inference, and unknown fields. Do not touch realtime detection, MQTT, Gemini, backend, DB, embeddings, S3 PUT, or anonymization. Use minimal changes and no committed video/frame artifacts.

### Lane A — Extraction and contracts
Inspect existing VLM code/tests first. Implement deterministic eight-frame extraction and strict frame/result contracts with focused unit coverage. Keep raw frames in memory and clean temporary downloads in finally paths.

### Lane B — CLI and provider integration
Inspect existing scripts/process_vlm.py, ai/vlm_sdk.py, and ai/vlm/incident_pipeline.py. Wire local/file/HTTP input through extraction into MockVlmProvider while preserving nested metadata and one-line JSON stdout behavior. Add focused integration/CLI tests without touching realtime/MQTT paths.

### Lane C — Verification and regression
Review both delivery lanes against all stated acceptance criteria. Add or adjust synthetic-video regression tests for unique frames, increasing timestamps, deterministic hashes, <=7-frame failure, corruption, invalid range, exact provider count, stdout/stderr contracts. Run python -m pytest tests/test_vlm_process.py -q; python -m pytest tests/test_incident_vlm_pipeline.py -q; python -m compileall ai scripts; git diff --check. Report concrete evidence and any compatibility risks.
